test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ram alone can finish a task in 20 days while Shyam alone can finish it in 30 days. How many days will they take to finish the task if they work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Ram to finish the work = 20 days

Time taken by Shyam to finish the work = 30 days

**Concept Used:**

Per day work = 1 ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by Ram in one day = (1)/(20) units

⇒ Work done by Shyam in one day = (1)/(30) units

⇒ If they work together,

⇒ Efficiency to finish the work = (1)/(20)+(1)/(30)

⇒ Efficiency to finish the work = (3+2)/(60)=(5)/(60)

⇒ Efficiency to finish the complete work = (1)/(12)

⇒ Time taken by both to complete the work = 12 days

**Therefore, while working together Ram and Shyam take 12 days to complete the work.**
